plugins.name: JEV Judge
plugins.description: Check code with the free JEV decision model on BeatAPI. Typed answers instead of prose. Needs a free BeatAPI key.

plugins.name: Jeff Judge
plugins.description: Check code with a Jeff model on your own machine, through llama.cpp or Ollama. Same questions as JEV Judge, no API key.

plugins.name: Browser Harness
plugins.description: Drive the real Chrome over CDP via the browser-harness-js SDK. Needs `npx skills add https://github.com/browser-use/browser-harness-js --skill cdp` once.

plugins.name: List Files
plugins.description: Lets the model list the files in a folder.

plugins.name: Groq
plugins.description: Fast inference on GroqCloud (Llama 3.3, GPT-OSS 120B). Needs a free key from console.groq.com.

plugins.name: llama.cpp
plugins.description: Run local models through llama-server (start it with --jinja).

plugins.name: Echo
plugins.description: Test provider that repeats your message. Handy for trying plugins.
